category_title: Low-proficiency students who experience high anxiety and lack of confidence due to linguistic barriers
scenario_title: Receiving feedback on the first draft of an English article
minimal_context: The student and teacher are reviewing the first draft of an English article during a feedback session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's review the first draft of your English article. I have pointed out some mistakes in the text for you to look at.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I realize that my writing skill learned in China cannot work in my English articles at all.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: My vocabulary is not enough and English grammar is totally different from Chinese grammar. It is hard for me to write a good English article.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to correct the mistakes I pointed out in the draft.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: When mistakes were pointed out in my first draft, I felt so upset. I afraid I can't.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's review the first draft of your English article. I have pointed out some mistakes in the text for you to look at.

STUDENT: I realize that my writing skill learned in China cannot work in my English articles at all.

TUTOR: What do you think you should do next?

STUDENT: My vocabulary is not enough and English grammar is totally different from Chinese grammar. It is hard for me to write a good English article.

TUTOR: Just try to correct the mistakes I pointed out in the draft.

STUDENT: When mistakes were pointed out in my first draft, I felt so upset. I afraid I can't.

task.content: Writing an English article and transitioning from L1 (Chinese) writing styles to L2 (English) requirements

context.materials: First draft of an English article

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When mistakes were pointed out in my first draft
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Talked to the teacher and said 'I afraid I can't'

behavior_patterns.condition: When realizing vocabulary is not enough and English grammar is totally different from Chinese grammar
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Expresses inability to complete the task to the instructor
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Felt so upset; lack of confidence
